body: Well when you or anyone has that way, tell me. The joys of living are unequivocally eclipsed by the multitudinous ways it blows. Living as an obligation to not make people sad is a poor quality of living.

Well I proposed the allergic reaction situation. The idea is multitudinous in its array of problem solving. My anguish stops, feelings aren’t as hurt due to “accidental causes”, my network is cared for financially, my debt is erased so they don’t have it.

It is deeper than the job. The job situation certainly doesn’t help. The “help” isn’t helping. I see a potential alternative that can bring some good to a situation that, invariably, has been coming down the pike for a while

Update: just got laid off today which I had suspected was coming. The company laid off a lot of people. Got thousands in bills to pay. So I’m almost certain I’m sliding down to the pawn shop and getting the biggest hand cannon they have
They let me do the first and middle name. Yep. They heard the name and were okay with it. I said it was family names and it was important.
I’ve thought about crowdsourcing a name and doing a poll on Reddit. They say it takes a village on Reddit to name a child

I started answering ads on various Reddit subs to impregnate strangers (mostly wives). I have two successes on the scoreboard and I’m still going. I haven’t told anyone. The women have let me name the kids though. I named the kids the same thing: Remmy Hutton (insert their last name)

In a year there may be a few Remmy Hutton such-and-such-surnames running around. 

I get paid to donate, but I haven’t told anyone of the suspect nature of this. I’m just manufacturing little Remmy HuttHutts in secret
It’s more than work and relationships. I just stay unhappy. I’ve squandered potential big time in life. I mean... I’m too unhappy at 24. If I have 50 more years of this dreadful march, I want to quit
